data.description:
## Context
The CI-equivalent default suite passes but 13 grounding tests emit `DeprecationWarning` from Python's `multiprocessing/popen_fork.py`: the process is multi-threaded and use of `fork()` may lead to deadlocks in the child. The warnings arise in `tests/unit/grounding/test_conformance.py` and `tests/unit/grounding/test_harness.py` under xdist worker execution.

## Reproduction
Run the default suite with `-n 4 --dist worksteal` and warnings enabled; the warning is emitted repeatedly while grounding harness subprocess tests execute.

## Plan
Use rebar-debug to trace the exact process-creation path and distinguish production harness behavior from test-only multiprocessing setup. Prove the root cause under a deterministic warning-as-error oracle before changing start methods or subprocess semantics. Any cross-platform process-model change requires explicit behavior review.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A deterministic focused reproduction identifies the exact fork call path and owning code.
- [ ] The affected grounding tests pass with this warning class promoted to an error.
- [ ] The repair preserves timeout, cleanup, and child-process isolation contracts across supported platforms.
- [ ] Focused concurrency tests and repository gates pass.
data.title: Grounding harness tests fork from multithreaded workers and warn about deadlock risk
